_doc: Fase D — Angles V2. `family` is the visual intention of the image (framing/photographic priority); it never says what the people are DOING (that is `interaction`, resolve_interaction in composition.py) or WHERE (that is `context`). `families` is the 6 populated top-level groups a screen shows, plus one reserved for later (`action_movement`: no system angle maps into it yet — nothing in the current 13 legacy angles is purely about bodily motion the way sport/dance would be; kept as a placeholder family so a future preset has somewhere to land without a catalog migration). `angles` is the SYSTEM catalog (scope=system, organization_id=null, store_id=null): every entry is additive metadata (family/preset/objective_hints/etc.) layered on top of the EXISTING 13 angle ids — it changes no prompt text and no compiler output. `legacy_aliases` maps every one of the 13 old ids to exactly one system angle id, carrying the flavor that fold lost as `objective_hints` (so a NOSTALGIA_ORIGEM plan is still legible as 'editorial_portrait, reflective', not just 'editorial_portrait'). `canonical_legacy_for` is the reverse route recommend_angle() uses: family (+ a hint, for the two families that fold two legacy angles) -> the ONE legacy angle_id that actually drives generation, so the compiler/prompt pipeline needs no change at all.

connection.label: Conexão / vínculo

action_movement.label: Ação / movimento
action_movement.description: Reservada: nenhum ângulo atual mapeia aqui. Para quando houver um preset de movimento corporal (esporte, dança) que hoje não existe no catálogo.

product_focus.label: Produto em foco

product_no_person.label: Produto sem pessoa
product_no_person.description: Só a peça — pendurada, em flatlay ou em still editorial.

creator_social.label: Creator / social
creator_social.description: Linguagem de rede social (selfie, foto de amigo) — nunca finge depoimento.

canonical_legacy_for._doc: family -> legacy angle_id, the one recommend_angle() routes to so the untouched v1/v2 prompt pipeline runs unchanged. A family with more than one legacy source (lifestyle, connection, editorial_portrait) picks by objective_hint; the fallback (no hint, or hint not listed) is the first/base legacy angle. `by_hint` keys accept BOTH vocabularies recommend_angle/angle_family_hint may pass: an objective_hint (e.g. 'print_detail') and, for families with a real preset, the preset name itself (e.g. 'print_closeup') — both point at the same legacy id.

discontinued_as_top_level._doc: Still fully functional as aliases (angle_id keeps working, byte-identical prompt) and still reachable via family+hint. Not offered as their own top-level card in a V2 screen: IDENTIDADE_ORIGEM folds into lifestyle (its 'integrated with a place' idea is what Context/semantic_context already express); PRESENTE_AFETO folds into connection (its whole distinguishing idea is the `gifting` interaction, which now exists as real data — showing a separate card would duplicate what the interaction picker already offers, breaking the Fase D rule 'angle must not duplicate interaction').
